_howto: Curated seed list for the public well (Phase 2). Intentionally EMPTY.
Add an address only if (a) its owner asked to be shown, or (b) it is a protocol/vault/treasury address that is publicly labeled as such.
Never add random wallets scraped from liquidation logs. The well is a map, not a hall of shame.
Format: { "address": "0x…" (lowercase), "label": "short public label", "addedBy": "who", "reason": "why it is fair to show" }
Cap: 250 ships on canvas. Pagination after that.
